K6.text: On the branch, every token path and token-gated byte route sends Cache-Control: private, no-store and X-Robots-Tag: noindex, and a test fails if a [token] route has no rule. Tokens are hashed with a TTL and revocable, and publicListing uses an allowlisted select. Referrer-Policy is still same-origin rather than no-referrer.
K6.change: cb75e58d: no-store + noindex path rules (invite, final-export, reset-password added); byte routes max-age=300 -> no-store
K6.gap_reason: Referrer-Policy is same-origin on purpose (SEC-08). With no-referrer, a native form POST sends Origin: null, Next's Server Action check refuses it, and every no-JS form on these token pages breaks. Closing this needs an owner decision: either accept same-origin (a decision-log row) or redesign the token pages so they don't rely on no-JS form posts.

K7.text: /:path* sets Referrer-Policy same-origin, nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY and HSTS (2y, includeSubDomains). The proxy CSP sets frame-ancestors 'none'. Checked against the config and the existing config test.

K8.text: Cron uses timingSafeEqual and fails closed when CRON_SECRET is unset, through the shared cronRoute on all three cron routes. The inbound-email secret is header-only and compared in constant time, and returns 503 when unset. Stripe/Resend/Twilio verifiers compare in constant time and reject when unset. The NEXT_PUBLIC_ vars (APP_URL, OPERATIONS_PHONE, STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY) are not secrets, and the only env file tracked is .env.example. I grepped for non-constant compares and found none.

K9.text: Stripe: the signature is checked on request.text() with a 300s window. The handler claims the event with a ProcessedStripeEvent insert, and a throw marks it failed so Stripe's retry can retake it (stale claims after 15 min too). Resend: Svix signature with a 300s window, and status updates are monotonic (shouldApplyStatus). Twilio's scheme has no timestamp; inbound is idempotent on MessageSid. Full read this pass.

Checked with a full grep of console output plus the adapter code.
